'''Benson Stanley Farb''' (born October 25, 1967) is an American mathematician at the [[University of Chicago]]. His research fields include [[geometric group theory]] and [[low-dimensional topology]].

==Early life==
A native of [[Norristown, Pennsylvania]], Farb earned his bachelor's degree from [[Cornell University]].{{citation needed |date=December 2021}} In 1994, he obtained his doctorate from [[Princeton University]], under the supervision of [[William Thurston]].<ref name="math">{{MathGenealogy |id=18914 }}</ref>

==Career==
Farb has advised over 40 students, including [[Pallavi Dani]], [[Kathryn Mann]], [[Dan Margalit (mathematician)|Dan Margalit]], [[Karin Melnick]] and [[Andrew Putman]].<ref name="math"/>

In 2012, Farb became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list|title= List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|access-date=2012-12-02}}</ref> In 2014, he was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Seoul]], speaking in the section on Topology.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathunion.org/icm-plenary-and-invited-speakers?combine=farb|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers|publisher=[[International Mathematical Union]]|access-date=2019-05-28}}</ref> He was elected to the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.amacad.org/new-members-2021|title=New Members Elected in 2021|publisher=American Academy of Arts and Sciences|access-date=2021-04-22}}</ref> In 2024, he was awarded the [[Leroy P. Steele Prize]] for Mathematical Exposition.<ref>[http://www.ams.org/news?news_id=7251 Leroy P. Steele Prize 2024]</ref>

==Personal life==
Farb married [[Amie Wilkinson]], professor of mathematics at the [[University of Chicago]], on December 28, 1996. They are professors in the same department.<ref>{{cite news |title=Amie Wilkinson, Benson S. Farb |url=https://www.nytimes.com/1996/12/29/style/amie-wilkinson-benson-s-farb.html |work=[[New York Times]] |date=December 29, 1996 |language=en |access-date=2021-12-14}}</ref>
